content: Note: the following entry is a stub. Each one is responsible for taking care of the Garden once a week.Influence, Outcomes, and EffectsAn example of active citizenship that transformed a garbage dump into a community garden.Analysis and Lessons LearnedSmall actions can change the reality of a place.See alsoReferencesExternal Linkshttp://www.portalnews.com.br/_conteudo/2017/02/cidades/50938-moradores-criam-jardim-comunitario.htmlNotes
